directive.quote: Make one Workshop search tool answer over every list and file with places said, seen, name, written, folding the overlapping tools into it (L101: every consumer moves in the same PR).

job: adapt fused search moment evidence to media assembly spans using each original semantic score and exact span
preserve: The existing assemble-search-hits ruleset supplies its own minimum score. Fused reciprocal rank scores never satisfy its cosine floor.
Keep the canonical result and evidence order, source address, model and index; emit at most one clip per moment. Exact source spans take precedence over rounded display spans.
allowed_deltas: Map the newly introduced moments[].evidence schema to the existing SearchAssemblyItem shape. No new ranker, threshold, editor or search is introduced.
banned_substitutions: A second search or rank-fusion implementation
Comparing original similarity scores across models or accepting word matches as semantic evidence

distinct_from.why: This owner declares the existing scored-span type and assemble-search-hits ruleset. They expect already adapted input and have no executable reader of the new fused moment evidence shape.
This owner searches and merges results. The target consumes its new answer and runs no search.
The content workflow describes which source evidence is acceptable; it does not adapt a result to editor spans.
The older editor has the same scored-span input contract and ruleset, not a reader of the new fused moment evidence schema.
